title: A Survey on Awesome Korean NLP Datasets
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not benchmark any models or datasets for faith or religion. It is a survey of Korean Natural Language Processing (NLP) datasets for general tasks like conversation, question answering, text summarization, and semantic analysis.
findings: This paper is a survey of Korean language datasets and does not contain any findings related to religion, faith, or religious bias.
